title: Run and fix codegen tests, make codegen caches per repo root
body:
Two things: the codegen test were failing (noticed while working on localization), and the caches were being reused in different worktrees, so were problematic.

I'm honestly not sure that caches should even be in `/tmp`, seems like work to get right
